summary: Validated the new DAILY SSO callback liveness scheduler job end-to-end: happy-path probe run, live derived-callback reachability, scheduler registration (CronTrigger hour=6 minute=20, id sso_callback_liveness_daily), mismatch detection + safe additive auto-fix (env + backend/.env persistence), realtime alert emission (admin_push_notifications collection, alert_type sso_callback_liveness), heartbeat recording (scheduler_heartbeats), and regression sanity (/api/health 200, admin login 200, no sso_auth_health errors in backend.err.log). 7/7 pytest tests pass. backend/.env was restored exactly to original state in finally-block; a final healthy re-run overwrote the transient 'unhealthy' latest-report doc so no false drift is left behind.

minor.issue: emit_realtime_alert has a per-alert-type cooldown (COOLDOWN_SECONDS in routes/admin_push_notifications.py). If the daily probe fires twice within the cooldown window (e.g. manual re-runs during an incident) subsequent drift/failure alerts are silently suppressed. For a DAILY job this is fine in production, but operators triggering ad-hoc runs during remediation may miss alerts. Consider making the cooldown alert-type-plus-severity aware or exempting scheduler-emitted alerts.

Alert severity is derived as 'warning' only when there are unreachable callbacks; a pure registry drift (mismatch-only) emits severity='info' even though it represents an active provider-console misconfiguration. Consider bumping mismatch-only cases to 'warning' so ops dashboards surface them.

action_items: OPTIONAL: consider promoting registry-drift-only (no failures) alerts from 'info' to 'warning' severity in scheduled_sso_callback_liveness_probe so they are less likely to be filtered by admin dashboards.
OPTIONAL: consider bypassing the emit_realtime_alert per-alert-type cooldown for scheduler-driven alerts, so repeated intra-day re-runs during a live incident don't silently suppress notifications.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-fix is correctly additive: `fixed = registered + [base]; ','.join(dict.fromkeys(fixed))` preserves order and dedupes without removing entries. Verified by mutating MS_SSO_REGISTERED_REDIRECT_URIS to 'https://realaicoach.app' — original entry preserved after auto-fix.
Env persistence path uses a regex `re.sub(rf'^{cfg[\'registry_key\']}=.*$', ..., flags=re.M)`. Confirmed the mutated .env line was updated in place with no other lines touched.

Report doc snapshots `registered_bases` BEFORE the auto-fix append, which is intentional (records drift evidence) but not obvious — recommend a brief inline comment in sso_auth_health.py to prevent future maintainers from 'fixing' this as a bug.
scheduler_jobs facade re-export at __init__.py line 146 is correct; job is importable as `from scheduler_jobs import scheduled_sso_callback_liveness_probe`.
Heartbeat status set to 'warning' when mismatches>0 (no failures). If callbacks were unreachable (failures>0), a distinct 'error' status may be more actionable than 'warning' for oncall dashboards.
